text:
Ivy (Design): quick drop 1 'Rewind affordance' concept for version history. idea: tiny inline "rewind" handle that opens a compact keyboard-first panel showing diff excerpt, canary flag, and a tiny 'confidence timeline' sparkline. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz/rewind

Mark (PM): neat. two asks: 1) how does this behave on mobile? 2) how do we surface partial canary data?

Ivy (Design): mobile: long-press on timeline item opens the same panel; on small screens we show stacked cards instead of slideovers. partial canary shows as "canary (partial metrics)" + a tooltip.

Sam (Eng): implementation notes: make the panel keyboard-activatable (Enter/Space), and lazy-load the full diff. include aria-busy during fetch. for confidence sparkline we'll return a compact bitmap/svg to avoid heavy client math.

Ruth (A11y): a11y nits: color + sparkline insufficient. include text status like "Confidence: Low/Medium/High" and an aria-live region for updates. panel must be role="dialog" with focus trap and Esc to close. provide skip-link to jump back to timeline.

Ivy (Design): added sample aria snippet in notes: <button aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Open rewind panel for v123: author Lee, canary partial">Rewind</button>

Sam (Eng): also suggestion: surface a "near-miss" indicator if a previous rollback was attempted but canceled 1 helps support avoid duplicate actions. that requires telemetry with attempt_status.

Mark (PM): good call. track experiment on two interaction models: A) rewind-handle -> compact panel + undo-toast vs B) select-then-action workflow (multi-select revisions then revert). measure accidental_revert_rate and time_to_revert. experiment ids: rewind_handle_v1, select_revert_v1.

Theo (Support): support prefers the multi-select workflow for bulk reverts, but single-item quick-revert is useful. add a 'View diagnostics' link in the panel to open full logs before confirming.

Ruth (A11y): toast undo must be keyboard-focusable and announced (aria-live="polite"). avoid using color to indicate canary; include textual badge. also ensure focus order: timeline -> open panel -> Confirm -> Cancel -> close.

Ivy (Design): microcopy tweak: Confirm CTA -> "Revert to this revision" ; secondary -> "Cancel". Undo toast copy: "Reverted to v123 — Undo" (available for 5 minutes).

Sam (Eng): engineering caveat: when rewinding to a revision that was mid-canary, the backend must warn about incomplete metrics; surface that warning in panel and in analytics. also add idempotency token for revert calls. CSS note for reduced motion: .panel { transition: max-height 200ms ease; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .panel { transition: none; } }

Ivy (Design): pushed updated frames. design-ci: snapshot created for 'rewind-affordance' by Ivy at 1769991150

Mark (PM): schedule 15min with Eng + A11y to pick defaults and analytics schema. thanks team. :thumbsup:
